item.title: Go God Man
item.author: thekingsscribe7@gmail.com (se7en Adeniyi)
item.description:
Many are they who stop at beingmerely man; will you become GODMan?

GOD speaks forth, “calling into being, what He has imagined. "
His Spirit, accomplishes (incubation) it.
It is finished. Done. Made MANIFEST.

GodMAN fellowships with GOD’s word (seed)
The Word bears fruit in the man.
By this, GOD.FAITH, 👇🏽

GodMAN speaks forth, “calling into being, what his zedek heart has imagined. "
the words, being of zedek heart = “in Jesus name”
His resting-Spirit {QAVAH} incubates it.
It is finished. Done. Made MANIFEST.

GodMAN operates, and is fruitful,
by GOD’s Word and Spirit.

Jesus is GOD’s Word, given physical expression.
What GOD’s spoken thoughts look like.

If a MAN would become full-stature GodMAN, it must be by:

abiding in God’s Spirit and TRUTH
being immersed (steeped) in GOD’s Word and
being immersed in; and filled evermore, with GOD’s Spirit.

GOD’s Spirit is TRUTH.
GOD’s Word is TRUTH.
To abide/ have the Word dwell richly in me = To be filled with the Holy Spirit

item.title: Why Marry
item.author: thekingsscribe7@gmail.com (se7en Adeniyi)
item.description:
Origin of Marriage

Man’s purpose is to reign as regent, over God’s creation. While that could be a little to vast to wrap our heads around, the simplified truth, is that we are meant to seek GOD’s Kingdom first, in ALL things; and learn to live by His righteousness. {see Matthew 6v33}.

In. ALL. Things.

All things include marriage—very important.
In the beginning, GOD gave Adam a wife so that she could help “this man. "
The designation, “this man, " meant that Adam, who knew his divine purpose and was walking in it through fellowship with GOD, was qualified to receive specialised tactical support—a help, meet / fit for him.

Now, I do not mean to demean the woman, but if a man needs a tractor; he NEEDS a tractor. Not a harvester; nor a bulldozer; but a tractor. GOD had observed Adam a while, and decided, “this man needs a fit help.” So, GOD had Adam name all the animals. Strange! If you know GOD at all, you know He makes nothing but strategic moves. So, after GOD says, this man needs a fit help, He proceeds to form every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and bring them to Adam to see what he would name them.

Now, I don’t know how much you know of GOD, so, I’ll tell you this: He never makes a one-way move. So many advantages in the big picture, are crammed into every minutia of His ways and counsel. Thus, there’s benefit to the beasts and birds; benefit to the man; benefit to the earth; to the woman that doesn’t exist yet; to the cosmos; the angels and spirits; and to GOD, Himself in every move/ choice GOD makes. Nevertheless, His every move is born of love.

Naming things isn’t quite what we make of it.
Oh boy! It goes steep and deep. It’s impossible for a creator like GOD to fashion something and not have a name for it.

Names are identity.
Inherent.

Take water, for instance.
What is water? What does that word really represent?
Scenario 1: A man is barely coherent, lying half dead in the dirt. “Water, " he whispers. Voice rasping.
Scenario 2: A young man bursts in the door. “Water! Water! The barn! "
Scenario 3: A foreigner who barely speaks any English, runs into a diner. Heart racing, pained expression. “Water! " he says, pointing at the old dam above the town.

If you aren’t one of the many, disgruntled by the programming through satanic media, your mind is sharp. You know that (1) is synonymous with life. For the dehydrated dying man, water is life. In (2), however, water is the rescuer, to save the barn from flames. And in (3). water is death—surging water has no mercy.

Why would “water” convey different meanings per context?
Is it the name, or the fact that it’s given voice; carried on breath?
Why are words spoken, but names, called?
Can we distinguish words from names?
Fred, pig, water, shoe; those are names.
Why, and, but, could; those are words. I believe.
Leave me a comment with your thoughts.

Well, GOD had a purpose in mind with every beast and bird.
Him having a purpose, means He knew their names.
Names, you see, aren’t arbitrary/ merely assigned tags.
No, they’re the thing; interpreted.

Consider an object we see in the nightsky. It twinkles. We call it, “star.”
Now, whatever (or whomever) is called a star, we deduce, must be placed above, and have lustre. Oh, here’s another. A machine that does computations; we’ll call it a computer.

So, GOD was testing, among other things, Adam’s perceptual understanding and intuition to decipher inherent purpose and interpret it as names. This was important, because whatever the man said, would hold. It’s kinda like getting your teenager a lawn mower and watch him manage it for months; before ever getting him a ride (car). If he called the mower a tincan and let it run off into the lake, you’d probably rethink that Tesla.

Through his naming of beast and bird, GOD ascertained that Adam’s discernment and intellect were up to par for him to subsequently, receive and name a wife. Well, dear man, do you still want to marry? Who, pray tell, is that 🫵🏽?! No! Not her. He didn’t name her first, remember?! He named everything else that the LORD GOD had placed in his care / domain. What has GOD put in your care?! Don’t know? Don’t you dare marry, then!

A second thing. When Adam was done naming the beasts and bords, it was reported, “there was not found a help meet / fit for him. "

Hey! GOD, I thought this was about naming beasts and birdies!
Why the inclusion of “error 404: fit help not found! "

“Well, you see, Son, I knew he didn’t have fit help. He (Adam) needed to know it too.
Like your marketers say, you’ve gotta show ’em the pain, before the product. " - GOD

Now, I’ve got to tell you.
I can just imagine Adam, seeing all these beasts and birdies, each with its mate. Lovebirds cuddling; lions and their lionesses… If it were me, I’d shoot GOD a side eye; like, “where’s my mate? I just discovered I’m a virgin. Hey! Didn’t you tell me to replenish the earth? How is a man (me) supposed to make babies?! All the beasts and birdies have babies. I’m the regent, and I ain’t got nothin! "

Side note: GOD will tell you to do stuff, HE knows you can’t do without specific help; and wait. He needs you to come to the same conclusion; and then, you can receive His help. He isn’t a mean fella waiting for us to grovel before He helps us. He just needs us on the same page.

Okay. So, GOD and man, BOTH, now know that the man needs help meet / fit for him.
And GOD puts the man into a deep sleep. I’d like to be mischievous and say that GOD flicked Adam in his forehead and said, “boy, Go to sleep; " but, I know HIM. He sang a note, so GOD-core, that my man Adam, was out cold, the moment he heard it.

GOD opens up Adam’s side, borrows a rib (genome print in the marrow), and from it, makes woman. That’s copy and paste the code; then edit. Nice! Adam wakes up, perfectly whole as far as he knows, and resumes his evening. Then, GOD brings her to him.

“Woah! It’s like looking at myself; but with conspicuous modifications.”
By the very same discernment with which he’d named the animals, he saw, as it were, a vision through GOD’s eyes as the LORD had taken his rib and made her out of it. He didn’t need asking. He named her right away, “she shall be called woman; for she was taken out of man. "

So, why then should you marry?
Only if you’ve committed yourself to walk with God all your days, and having begun to do so, YAHWEH has called upon you, His Son, to behold His daughter. Or that you, His daughter, be beheld by His son.

And to this end, shall the Union be:
That you both, as one, might seek first the Kingdom of GOD & His Zedek,caccording to His word onto you (the man).
